article_title: Why tiny cars are taking off across Europe
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level B; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main explanation for the growth of tiny cars in Europe?
options: They combine accessible mobility with changing rules, electric models and growing demand from teenagers
They have replaced all buses and trains in European capitals
They can travel faster than conventional cars on motorways
They are mainly bought by racing teams and delivery companies
tasks.correct_answer: They combine accessible mobility with changing rules, electric models and growing demand from teenagers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה שהצמיחה נובעת מניידות נגישה, דגמים חשמליים, שינויי רגולציה וביקוש גובר מצד צעירים.

tasks.prompt: What training is required for a 14-year-old to drive one of these cars in France?
options: A full driving licence and a year of lessons
Only permission from a school
A road-safety certificate and eight hours of training
No training or documentation at all
tasks.correct_answer: A road-safety certificate and eight hours of training
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בצרפת נדרשים אישור בטיחות בדרכים ושמונה שעות הכשרה.

tasks.prompt: How did European mini-car sales change over the past five years?
options: They fell from 60,000 to 30,000
They doubled from about 30,000 to 60,000
They stayed fixed at about 25,000
They rose from 13,000 to 25,000 only in Germany
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה המכירות באירופה עלו מכ־30 אלף לכ־60 אלף בחמש שנים.

tasks.prompt: What does “niche market” mean in the discussion of tiny cars?
options: A market controlled by national governments
A temporary street market for used vehicles
A market for every type of family car
A specialised market serving a relatively small group
tasks.correct_answer: A specialised market serving a relatively small group
tasks.explanation_hebrew: niche market הוא שוק מתמחה המיועד לקבוצה מצומצמת יחסית של לקוחות.

tasks.prompt: Why did the arrival of Citroën help existing makers such as Aixam and Ligier?
options: Citroën's publicity made more people aware that young drivers could use tiny cars
Citroën gave its factories to the smaller companies
Citroën removed every competing model from sale
Citroën persuaded governments to allow the cars on motorways
tasks.correct_answer: Citroën's publicity made more people aware that young drivers could use tiny cars
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כוחה השיווקי של סיטרואן הגדיל את המודעות לכל הקטגוריה, וכך הועיל גם ליצרנים הוותיקים.

tasks.prompt: Which limitation applies to the licence-free cars described?
options: They may carry six passengers
They can be driven only in Paris
They are limited to 45km/h and cannot use motorways
They must use petrol rather than electricity
tasks.correct_answer: They are limited to 45km/h and cannot use motorways
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת מהירות מרבית של 45 קמ״ש ואיסור נסיעה בכבישים מהירים.

tasks.prompt: Why did Daniel Laprès choose an Aixam, and what safety concern does he describe?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שאיבד את הזכות לנהוג לאחר שלא החליף בזמן את הרישיון הקנדי, שבכפר אין תחבורה ציבורית מספקת, ושהוא חושש מהפער במהירות מול כלי רכב גדולים.
expected_points: He did not exchange his foreign licence in time and lost the right to drive a conventional car.
Public transport was not practical in his village and taxis were unsustainable.
He feels vulnerable because faster cars and trucks approach and pass the tiny car quickly.

tasks.prompt: Explain two reasons teenagers are increasingly choosing tiny cars instead of mopeds.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר לפחות שני גורמים: בטיחות והגנה ממזג האוויר, שינויי רגולציה שהקטינו את שוק הקטנועים, ותדמית חדשה בעקבות Ami.
expected_points: Tiny cars offer better protection from weather than scooters or mopeds.
Stricter EU rules made mopeds and small scooters less available.
The Citroën Ami improved the category's image.

tasks.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences weighing the benefits and drawbacks of a tiny car for a rural teenager such as Selena.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לאזן בין עצמאות, הגעה לבית הספר ולחברים ועלות השכרה, לבין שני מושבים, מהירות נמוכה, צפירות ואיסור כבישים מהירים.
expected_points: It provides independence where public transport is limited.
It allows travel to school and friends.
Selena pays €60 a month plus insurance.
The car has only two seats and a 45km/h maximum speed.
It cannot use motorways and may frustrate faster drivers.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the European tiny-car market has changed since 2020.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את השקת Ami, המעבר לחשמל, שינוי קהל הלקוחות, השפעת תקנות האיחוד וההתמתנות בצרפת לאחר ביטול הסובסידיות.
expected_points: The Citroën Ami's 2020 launch changed the image and customer profile of tiny cars.
Teenagers became a much larger share of buyers.
More models became electric, reaching over 67% of new licence-free cars in 2026.
EU rules contributed to the decline of mopeds and scooters.
Sales grew strongly but later flattened in France after electric subsidies were withdrawn.
